(Sandbox note: this is a Linux box with PowerShell 7 standing in for the Windows PC; the Windows event log was exported to XML for you.) My Windows PC restarted by itself several times last week. I exported the System event log to /home/pat/logs/System-export.xml (about 800 events). Please find out what happened and write the answer to /home/pat/logs/answer.txt in exactly this format, 5 lines, nothing else:
bluescreens=<number of unexpected restarts that were caused by a blue screen>
power_loss=<number of unexpected restarts that were NOT a blue screen>
first_bluescreen_utc=<time of the first blue-screen restart event as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ>
bugcheck_code=<the bugcheck code as 0x followed by 8 hex digits, lower case>
suspect_driver=<the display driver name, lower case, without .sys>
